name: Home Assistant — Lights
description: An at-a-glance overview of a room (or whole-house) set of light.* entities: which are on, how bright, what colour, and what share of the house is currently lit. Each row carries a brightness mini-bar tinted by the light's actual colour-temperature (warm-white to cool-white) or RGB hue, plus a swatch dot for the colour itself. Reads from your existing Home Assistant install via the Core plugin.
